6. Test the correction against the original failure.
7. Run relevant negative tests and regression tests.
8. Verify that other working components remain unaffected.
9. Roll back the change if material regressions appear.
10. Preserve the evidence and assign the next productive task.

No worker may claim to be repaired without a successful relevant retest.

A supervisor must escalate failures involving missing authorization, security-sensitive operations, customer commitments or unresolved financial risk rather than attempting an unauthorized workaround.
